text_block_list.text:
After safely finishing the Nippon Derby 
and taking a rest day, the first training 
day arrived—
choice_data_list:
Then try running through it at an easy 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

"A captivating, powerful start... And 
she's only polished it further—"

Duramente's running was just like always. 
And yet, something... something felt off. 
It was almost purely an intuition, but—

Just to be extra safe, I cut training 
short and took Duramente in for an 
examination. As a result—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly glad you came in to see a doctor 
early.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There's an abnormality in the bone. Though 
it's a very mild symptom.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Still, you noticed it quickly, didn't you? 
You didn't feel any pain at all, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely. I made sure to stay on 
the lookout for even the slightest 
anomaly, but...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: I suppose so. It's that minor.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I believe follow-up observation will be 
sufficient. She should be able to enter 
races again very soon.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...That is...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Would your diagnosis remain the same even 
during an overseas campaign?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not quite right.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Overseas campaigns are harsh. The change 
in environment is drastic... No matter how 
resilient an Umamusume is, spending time 
just as they do in Japan is virtually 
impossible.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There have even been cases where an 
Umamusume pushed through a minor ailment 
to race away from home... and it ended her 
entire athletic career.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Though, that is only in the worst-case 
scenario. Until your concerns are 
resolved, I would not recommend attempting 
it. Please discuss it thoroughly between 
the two of you."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ... Thank... you very much.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Tell me your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Should I give up on this year's Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe? Or... push straight 
forward as is?

Duramente gazes straight at me. There is 
no expectation or pleading in her clear 
eyes. She is simply... waiting for my 
answer.

Of course, I want her to take on the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe. If it is Duramente, 
I believe she will show us a glorious 
result that rewrites history.

Still... more than records, more than 
wishes, more than anything... the present 
and future Duramente is what truly 
matters.
choice_data_list:
Let's give up on this year's Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Understood. Let's give up on this year.

Surprised by how unexpectedly easy she 
accepted it, I instinctively replied. To 
Duramente, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
should be her most precious dream above 
all else.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You decided that now is not the time. Then 
I shall simply obey.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let's return to the academy and completely 
reschedule everything.

Duramente likely knew what had to be done 
the moment she heard the doctor speak. 
While I, her Trainer, was still 
hesitating.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you apologizing?
choice_data_list: If only I had more skill...
If only I were more skilled...

text_block_list.text:
If we had the knowledge, experience, and 
training techniques to foster growth while 
caring for her body during overseas 
campaigns, perhaps we wouldn't have had to 
give up on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

However, with my current inexperience, I 
don't have the confidence to take her 
overseas in her present condition and 
bring her back safely.
choice_data_list: If I wasn't the one in charge—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: *I* was the one who wanted you.

"I will without fail prove that Duramente 
is the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You... came to know my imperfect self. And 
bore this heavy burden right alongside 
me...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This is the path you and I chose together. 
I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you gave me something truly 
precious.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Before the Japan Derby... Mental 
discipline training with Universe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Without that training, it might have led 
to an even more severe injury than this.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even now, you're the one who noticed signs 
so subtle I missed them, preventing 
injuries before they could happen.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not good with words. But if you 
aren't convinced, I will continue."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...the reason why I'm glad you're my 
Trainer. ...What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Then let us move forward. About our 
upcoming schedule.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Just now, you said you lacked confidence 
in an overseas expedition."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However—things at home will be different, 
won't they?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Taking on the Kikuka Sho. Here is my 
plan.

The Kikuka Sho... The final race of the 
Classic Triple Crown. Umamusume compete 
over the brutal distance of 3,000m, vying 
for that last crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The race where 'the strongest Umamusume 
wins'... That is the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Then winning there too would be yet 
another way to prove I am the 
strongest..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...You also taught me that there isn't 
just one way to be the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Trainer? Do you have the 
confidence to lead me to victory in the 
Kikuka Sho?

"Duramente gazes straight at me once 
again. However, this time in her eyes— 
there were expectations and trust."

The Kikuka-sho is a long-distance race 
unlike any of our target races so far. 
Truth be told, how well Duramente can 
adapt to it is an unknown, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's settled. After taking a few days of 
rest, let's bring together our training 
proposals.

We reached an agreement, but... it made me 
realize once again how inexperienced I am. 
The Umamusume under my care—who should be 
hurting the most—was the one cheering me 
up and even proposing her next race.

She hasn't given up on her dream of the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. That day will 
surely come. As her Trainer, I need to 
learn even more—
choice_data_list: (That's right, just like her family line—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Hm? You are...

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text: Good evening, Trainer. Welcome.

On the evening of the day we visited the 
hospital, I immediately contacted 
Duramente's father... and was invited to a 
party where members of the family had 
gathered.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I've already heard about Dura. What 
business do you have with me at such a 
critical time?"

All eyes at the party gathered upon us at 
once. For a moment, I flinched at the 
stellar lineup of famous athletes and 
trainers. However...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
It seems the Trainer wants to borrow our 
help.

Every member of Duramente's lineage 
utilized their abundant talent to take on 
the world. If we could borrow their 
experience and knowledge...

"I can grow so much as a Trainer. If I 
want to be of help to her going forward... 
I have no choice but to learn step by 
step, starting right now."
choice_data_list:
Please... I look forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you go through the trouble of 
coming all the way here just for something 
like that?"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
—If you had only called, I would have 
rushed over in a heartbeat!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate B
text_block_list.text:
If it's for Duramente's sake, I'd do 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate C
text_block_list.text: Because she is... our pride, and our hope!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. That desire of yours to 
"support" someone... I know that feeling 
all too well.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
When I met Duramente's mother... my wife, 
we were both still students.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
I was still green back then... but having 
fallen for my talented wife, I gave it my 
all to support her while still continuing 
my own athletic career.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you feel the same way too, 
Trainer. ...Let's do our best!

And so—starting that very day, study 
sessions for Duramente began, keeping the 
ultimate goal—the world—in sight.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
—The dumbbell's weight should be 'just a 
little challenging'! Here, Trainer, why 
don't you give it a try?

Taking time between tasks to visit members 
of the clan... learning from past 
precedents, the latest research papers, 
and active athletes, absorbing it all—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“—Starting today, we begin training for 
the Kikuka Sho. Let's do this.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, it said dumbbell training, but... 
as for the weight—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! That's...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...No, it's nothing. Let's continue."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad it was you. Truly.

And so, with our target race abruptly 
switched to the Kikuka Sho, the days of 
training began once again.
